notes.title: [Notice Microsoft's Window Defender's user]
notes.content:
Hi.

For users who using Microsoft Windows Defender,
Due to "Princess Maker 5" is recognized as a virus, it could not be normally installed and started.
For solution, please follow below the way which is through Microsoft helping us to save it.

First, please update the definition file of Microsoft Windows Defender,
https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/wdsi/definitions 

Second, please reinstall "Princess Maker 5".

If you have any other problem about Anti-virus, such as having trouble in installing or starting up.etc , please feel free to contact with us. 
Please send us the details of the problems, we will find out the solution to help you to take action.

Thank you.

notes.title: Installation and Startup Problems(Jun 4th)
notes.content:
Hi,

Some antivirus programs recognize Princess Maker 5 program as a virus, 
preventing its normal installation and program to start up.

We have now solved the problems with major antivirus tools as below. 

- V3
- Alyac
- BITDEFENDER 
- F-secure 
- Microsoft security essentials
- Malwarebytes

<Requesting Action At This Time>
- Avast free Antivirus

Please let us know the information on your antivirus tool if you still have similar problems, 
and we will take action accordingly.

Thank you.
